adapter_evidence.statement: each tap is driven by an OPA4197 voltage follower (U1602 to U1604); the ladder is fed by REF5050 U1601; source impedance is the closed-loop output impedance of the follower, not stated as a number (UNSOURCED); the 100 Ohm victim value of PRECISION is kept
